title: Mexican Tacos with Vibrant Salsa
description: A flavorful and colorful Mexican dish featuring tacos filled with comte cheese and topped with a vibrant salsa made with vibrant peppers.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the vibrant peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the comte cheese and stir until melted.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the cheese mixture onto a tortilla and topping with cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
